Class GameSession

java.lang.Object
com.cuseto.pong.game.session.GameSession
public final class GameSession extends Object
Holds the full mutable state of a Pong match: the arena, both paddles, the ball, the score, and the match's GameStatus.

The arena, paddle sizes/speed, and ball's initial velocity are derived once from AppConfig at construction and do not change for the lifetime of the session; paddle/ball positions and the score change as the match is played.

  • Constructor Details

    • GameSession

      public GameSession(AppConfig appConfig)
      Builds a new session from configuration: computes the arena and both paddles' starting positions, places the ball at the arena's center with its configured initial velocity, and sets the match status to GameStatus.RUNNING.
      Parameters:
      appConfig - the application configuration to derive the arena, paddle, and ball setup from

  • Method Details

    • resetRound

      public void resetRound()
      Resets the ball to the arena's center with its configured initial velocity, and returns both paddles to their vertically-centered starting positions. Used to begin a new round after a point is scored.

      Does not affect the score or GameStatus.

    • startNewMatch

      public void startNewMatch()
      Starts a fresh match: resets both scores to zero, clears any winner, sets the status to GameStatus.RUNNING, and resets the round via resetRound().

    • setGameOverAction

      public void setGameOverAction(Consumer<Player> action)
      Registers a callback to be invoked with the winning Player when the match ends. Replaces any previously registered callback.
      Parameters:
      action - the callback to invoke on game over, or null to clear it

    • incrementLeftScore

      public void incrementLeftScore()
      Awards a point to the left player. Does nothing if the match has already ended. If this point reaches the winning score, sets the left player as winner() and ends the match via setGameOver().

    • incrementRightScore

      public void incrementRightScore()
      Awards a point to the right player. Does nothing if the match has already ended. If this point reaches the winning score, sets the right player as winner() and ends the match via setGameOver().
